query: Millbrae CA planning "under construction" OR "approved" mixed-use OR apartments OR development 2026

results.title: Gateway at Millbrae Station: 400 apartments and hotel now under construction
results.content: The Gateway at Millbrae Station transit-oriented development includes 400 residential units, a 164-room hotel and 44,000 square feet of retail. Phase 2 is expected to deliver in Q3 2026.

results.title: Millbrae City Council approves 150-unit El Camino Real mixed-use project
results.content: The council approved a six-story mixed-use building at 1101 El Camino Real with 150 apartments and 8,500 sq ft of ground-floor retail. Construction could begin in 2026 with completion targeted for 2028.

results.title: Serra Station Apartments - 76 units near Millbrae BART approved
results.content: 76 units of housing at 100 El Camino Real. Approved by the Planning Commission; anticipated completion 2027.

results.title: Millbrae Station Area Specific Plan update
results.content: Draft plan update for the station area: up to 2,900 new homes and 1.5 million square feet of office over 20 years.

results.title: Millbrae approves affordable housing development on Rollins Road
results.content: The 120-unit affordable project on Rollins Road is approved; the developer expects to break ground in Q2 2026.
